title: Fetcher Service State
description: Makes an HTTP request on each pipeline trigger and injects the response body as the next pipeline value. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/fetcher)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, …

headers.description: Request headers (static or dynamic with = suffix)

body.description: Request body (raw JSON string or plain text)

bodyFormat.description: How the request body is produced (see below)

bodyExpression.description: Expression evaluated against params to produce the body; used when bodyFormat is "expression"
